biggest_catch: Neither you nor your friend is paid until the new Kasasa checking account completes its monthly qualifications for the first 3 consecutive months — and your custom referral code expires 30 days after it's issued.
catches: Both the existing member and the new referred member are paid $100 each only after the new membership checking account has completed the monthly qualifications for the first 3 consecutive months.
The number of referrals an existing member provides is not limited — unlimited referrals.
The member's custom referral code expires 30 days after it is issued.
The $100 referral payments are made within 3 business days of requirements being met, deposited automatically into the primary savings account (S1).

Credit union employees, officials, and members of their immediate family are not eligible; new referred member must open a new membership with a Kasasa checking account and be 18+; 1099-MISC issued at $600+/year in referral payments.

steps: Get your custom AAFCU referral code (expires 30 days after issuance).
Share the code with friends and family.
Your friend applies the referral code when opening a new AAFCU membership with a Kasasa checking account.
The new checking account completes the monthly Kasasa qualifications for the first 3 consecutive months.
You and your friend are each paid $100 within 3 business days, deposited into your primary savings accounts.
timing: $100 paid within 3 business days after the new account completes 3 consecutive months of qualifications.
